plugins.name: pbx-voice
plugins.description: Phone calls for agents through your own PBX. Bring the SIP credentials for an extension on a private or hosted PBX, and pbx-voice places wake-up alarms, spoken messages, and short AI conversations that bring back answers. Requires the pbx-voice binary (glibc-based Linux, x64 or arm64) and an xAI API key.
